sources.title: Qwen3-4B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B is a 4-billion parameter dense causal language model developed by Alibaba, belonging to the third generation of the Qwen series. A fundamental innovation in this model is its unified architecture that supports dual-mode operation, allowing for dynamic switching between 'thinking' and 'non-thinking' states.
